title: Russia’s Hybrid War Has Entered a Dangerous New Phase
gist: Teaser of former US NATO ambassador Julianne Smith's argument that Russia's hybrid war in Europe has entered a dangerous new phase that the West has done far too little to deter. She recounts how early attacks—cut undersea cables, incendiary parcels, arson on weapons factories—stayed below the collective-response threshold while NATO's posture remained largely defensive.

insights.claim: During the first years of the Ukraine war, Russia's hybrid attacks in Europe—undersea cable cuts, incendiary devices in cargo packages, and arson on weapons factories and depots—stayed just below the threshold that might trigger a NATO collective response.
insights.so_what: Defense manufacturing, logistics and subsea infrastructure in Europe are persistent sabotage targets.
